    Designer Notes

    A lavish lace midi dress embroidered with florals from top to bottom, pairing with low heels for sleek evening dinner elegance.

    • Midi dress with lace construction
    • Intricate lace with floral embroidery
    • Adjustable belted waist for a flattering fit
    • Slight A-line skirt with flowy hem
    • Flutter sleeves with uneven cuffs
    • Stand neckline with button placket
    • Leg split at front hem
    • Belt loops
    • Highest point to hem: 135.5cm (Size 10)
    • Concealed zip fastening
    • Button placket at front
    • Regular fit
    • Lined fabric

    With a belted waist and flutter sleeves, this makes a great choice for romantic dinners, family celebrations and elevated garden parties.

    Details

    Care instructions:

    Cold hand wash only, do not bleach, do not tumble dry.

    • Fabrication: Main: 68% Cotton, 32% Polyamide / Lining: 100% Viscose
    • Made in China

    Product # DR21375

    Model Sizing
    • Wears: Size

      Our model is wearing a size 8/XS. She usually takes a standard 8/XS, and is 5'11" (180cm) tall.
